findings.render_fail_closed: The renderer refuses to overwrite an existing body and requires exact root-preparation identity, six fixed code paths/hashes, a passing checker-source review bound to the checker bytes, non-payload proof pins, and exact typed/raw native exit-0 evidence before it creates a body. The emitted binding records root preparation, source review, template, checker, and native proof pins.
findings.typed_native_gate: The renderer requires the dictionary-native evidence schema and exact run/unit/invocation, active/exited state, strict integer MainPID=0/ExecMainCode=1/ExecMainStatus=0, timezone-qualified capture/exit times in order, and raw capture byte count/SHA/path. It joins raw unit identity, invocation, exit properties, and captured time. The remote template rechecks the captured raw receipt hashes/bytes, exact original admission and launch bytes, log bytes, and a fresh exact current unit snapshot with positive CPUUsageNSec.
findings.fresh_pre_mutation_gates: Before D.mkdir or any support submission, the template checks the approved Path exception, direct project/scratch paths, canonical interpreter, absent output directory and support unit, all fixed embedded payload pins, source manifest plus complete 167-file tree, canonical split, six registered data paths/resolved identities, native exit evidence and stat-only output inventory, ten read-only predecessor receipts, profile files, parent/dictionary identities, cache acceptance/stop/metadata and array stats, parent cgroup envelope/empty descendant inventory/headroom, and physical ext4 device/free-space constraints.
findings.predecessors_read_only: The template pins and reads the exact parent, dictionary, profile, CONTROL, and EMA acceptance/stop receipt set. Existing receipts are never recreated or restaged. The dictionary stat comparison follows its accepted path/bytes/device/inode/SHA shape and does not invent an mtime_ns requirement.
findings.payload_and_import_boundary: The fixed input map contains six code files and four bounded metadata inputs. The renderer reads exact pinned bytes and checks the rendered literal payloads; remote payload decoding checks exact names, sizes, caps, and SHAs before a checker subprocess is started. The checker is staged create-only in the private D directory after all fresh gates; the run model/state/cache/dictionary arrays remain stat-only in the outer admission, with their bounded content validation delegated to the reviewed checker.
findings.resource_and_unknown_outcome: The one-shot support unit is CPU-limited to 50%, MemoryHigh 1.4 GB, MemoryMax 1.5 GB, swap 0, runtime 600 seconds, CUDA hidden, and BLAS/thread variables set to one. The cgroup headroom check reserves one 1.5 GB support maximum plus 1 GB under the 17 GB target. Admission/intent/launch receipts use exclusive durable writes; uncertain submit outcomes are retained and never retried.
findings.no_native_stop_prerequisite: The gate requires the exact native dictionary invocation to be active/exited with successful exit fields. It does not require that native unit to have been stopped, and this template has no native stop action.

conditions_for_final_review: A fresh actual native exit-0 capture for invocation 73b10b699e034a1b9952b2377b845095 must be bound by the renderer; progress or expected update arithmetic is insufficient.
Review the exact final rendered body bytes and renderer report after native evidence is captured; this template-only review is not authorization to render, stage, admit, or execute.
Root must perform and bind the fresh actual admission gates immediately before the one support submission; this static review does not establish their current values.
